method.projection: (n x player mean + 4 x positional mean)/(n+4), then multiplied by an opponent factor: 1 + 0.5 x (clamped allowed/league ratio - 1).
method.distribution: Normal with the player's own game-level SD; 80% interval = mean +/- 1.28 SD.
method.no_market: No official league source publishes prop prices. Rather than invent a line or a price, market_line and edge are left blank and flagged.
